newsitem.title: USA: Colonial BancGroup to buy Dadeland Bancshrs.
newsitem.headline: Colonial BancGroup to buy Dadeland Bancshrs.

text.p: Colonial BancGroup and Dadeland Bancshares said on Monday the companies have agreed for Colonial to buy Miami-based Dadeland for $38 million cash.
Upon regulatory approval and approval by Dadeland's shareholders, the merger should be completed within four months, the companies said in a joint statement.
Dadeland Bank currently operates four offices in Miami and had assets of $137 million at March 31, 1997.
Colonial BancGroup is a multi-bank holding company headquartered in Montgomery, Ala. with assets of $6 billion and 171 full service offices in Alabama, Florida, Georgia and Tennessee.
